What is Soya DOC (De Oiled Cake)?

Soya DOC — short for Soya De-Oiled Cake — is the same product as soybean meal, commonly used term in India, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, and the Middle East. After soybean oil is extracted, the remaining high-protein cake is called Soya DOC. It contains 46–50% crude protein and is used identically to soybean meal in all livestock and poultry feed formulations.

With a crude protein content of 46–50%, our Soya DOC meets the nutritional requirements of all major livestock species. It is a primary ingredient in commercial poultry, cattle, dairy, swine, and aquaculture feed formulations globally. Whether you are searching for soybean meal, Soya DOC, de-oiled cake, or SBM 46%, Kartari Exim supplies the same premium quality product for all your animal feed requirements.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the difference between soybean meal and Soya DOC?

There is no difference — Soya DOC (De-Oiled Cake) and soybean meal refer to the same product. Soya DOC is the term commonly used in India and Asian markets, while soybean meal is the international term used globally.

What protein percentage does your soybean meal contain?

Our Soya DOC contains 46–50% crude protein, suitable for all major livestock, poultry, and aquaculture feed formulations.

Do you supply samples before bulk orders?

Yes, we can arrange product samples for quality testing and verification before confirming bulk orders.

Which countries do you export soybean meal to?

We export to buyers across Southeast Asia, the Middle East, East Africa, and South Asia.

What is the minimum order quantity?

We accommodate both small trial orders and full container loads. Please contact us with your requirement for a custom quote.

What certifications and documents do you provide?

We provide export documentation, phytosanitary certificates, COA, and quality analysis reports with every shipment.
